Name: Victorian sprinklers
Author: gelatinveins
Description:
This is a straightforward mod. Just replaces your sprinklers with a Victorian-based design. This is made to complement eemie's mods, but you are free to use them with whatever you want.

NOTE: [b]All three types of sprinklers will look the same.[/b] I did this because I just wanted them to be consistent. [b]Keep a backup[/b] of your springobjects.xnb file just in case this bothers you!

Let me know if there are any problems or concerns.

Where to put the file:
Stardew Valley/Content/TileSheets
Stardew Valley/Content/Maps

Copy the .xnb and put them in both files!
